
# Release Notes: Version 6.7.1
**Release Date:** November 18, 2025

---

## 🚀 New Features

 - Feature 1: Font required for updated (SVG) counter graphics is now included in the VASL VMOD, no need to separately download and install the font.
 - Feature 2: Counters for Slaughter at Ponyri added to the HASL and CGs section.
 - Feature 3: Counters for Twighlight of the Reich added to the German and Axis Minors counter palette sections.
 - Feature 4: Polish Eagles counters from Doomed Battalions Fourth Edition added to the Allied Minors counter palette section.
 - Feature 5: Added WW-I Russian armored trucks from "Special Operations" magazine ASL Scenario O5.
 - Feature 6: Adding full set of SASL dr/DR buttons (enabled via preference in VASL tab). Remove SASLDice extension as it is no longer needed.
 - Feature 7: Adding SASL suspect counter activation flags in conjunction with the SASL Campaign Game Roster version 4.0 (see the SASL CGR help for more details).
---

## 🛠 Bug Fixes
 - Fix 1: Fixed problems with concealment/mini-concealment counters.
 - Fix 2: Fixed reverse side of PF counters disapearing.
 - Fix 3: Fixed invisible "small" translucent Sniper counters.
 - Fix 4: Fixed Russian SU-76m not showing as open topped.
 - Fix 5: Fixed German Opel Blitz wreck not showing.
 - Fix 6: Fixed color mismatch of label text on customizable American blank counter.
 - Fix 7: Fixed smoke exponent for American 7-4-7 'E' Squad.
 - Fix 8: Fixed rendering of infantry "Class IDs".
 - Fix 9: Corrected color of Russian MMC unit depictions.
 - Fix 10: Corrected Japanese HMG PP value to '4'.
 - Fix 11: Corrected Japanese 50mm MTR range to "1-16".
 - Fix 12: Corrected typos on fortified building level counters.
 - Fix 13: Added SVG "shared"/white concealment counters.
 - Fix 14: Issue 1729 SdKfz 10/5 counter error fixed.
 - Fix 15: LOS now working again for maps with multiple columns of boards
 - Fix 16: Corrected Communist Chinese MMG & HMG PP and B#s.
 - Fix 17: Corrected malfunctioned side of Finnish LMG(r).
 - Fix 18: USMC Assault Engineer smoke exponent changed to 5.
 - Fix 19: US (Korea Forgotten War) M26A1 fast turret indicator reinstated.
 - Fix 20: Fix Partisan and Russian Paratrooper class IDs on broken side.
 - Fix 21: Fix manhandling on Japanese 76L and 120L AA guns, and regenerate Type 2 Ka-Mi w/ pontoons.
 - Fix 22: Fix NKVD and SaP para squads' broken sides.
 - Fix 23: Fix malfunctioned and dismantled Swedish 81mm Mortar.
 - Fix 24: Fix star shell draggable overlays.
 - Fix 25: Tweaking SASL Suspect counters, fixed font issue for AmmoB.
 - Fix 26: Fixing PP for dm Japanese 50mm SW mortars.
 - Fix 27: Communist Phone and Radio counter names with correct case.
 - Fix 28: Correct SS 5-4-8 AE smoke exponent from ‘2’ to ‘4’.
 - Fix 29: Fixing various vehicle wrecks not working.
 - Fix 30: Resolved counter linking crash.
 - Fix 31: Re-enabled various "mass remover" functions such as remove all "Gray Smoke", "Defensive Fire", "Residual Fire", etc.
 - Fix 32: Counter errors for Russian radio and Chinese MMG fixed.
 - Fix 33: LOS Bugs with missing Bridge and Gully/Stream locations fixed.

---

## 📈 Improvements
 - Improvement 1: Added LOS Checking to HASL bdDaE
 - Improvement 2: Changes to autosave feature so that users can select what directory files will be save to. Also changed how games are saved so that they do not get added to the recent games tab.
 - Improvement 3: Adjusted shade of red used in vehicle and gun counter notation to improve visibility.
 - Improvement 4: Adjusted position of vehicle movement point values for improved readabilty.
 - Improvement 5: Matched broken side "Class IDs" to the new good order side versions.
 - Improvement 6: Removed thin black stroke on "white" text OBA counter variants to improve readabilty.
 - Improvement 7: More closely matched BMG & RMG malfunction counters/Multi-fire counters/"Bad Things" flags to the physical game components.
 - Improvement 6: Added "Orchards to Olive Groves" transformation.
 - Improvement 9: Added "Airborne" text to British Airborne SW mortar.
 - Improvement 10: Adjusted position of PP text on several British SW counters to improve readability.
 - Improvement 11: Converted miscellaneous gun and vehicle counters to SVG.
 - Improvement 12: Adjusted 5/8" Smoke & WP text to interoperate with updated Nationality Smoke extension.
 - Improvement 13: Phase wheel converted to SVG.
 - Improvement 14: Drawing LOS now does not hide all the units, they are visible with reduced opacity.
 - Improvement 15: Make RST square on vehicles more pronounced.
 - Improvement 16: Debris Overlay added to Draggable Overlays; has changeable level background and works with LOS
 - Improvement 17: Sangar counter now has winter color
 - Improvement 18: Added “Out of Gas” and “Out of Gas Abandoned” counters.
 - Improvement 19: Added SVG Barrage counters.
 - Improvement 20: Panzer Lehr symbol updated.
 - Improvement 21: Update American counters’ label background color to match the new American counters’ base background color.
 - Improvement 22: LOS Code should work in all crop / flip configurations (for LOS enabled boards)

---

## ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
- **Minimum Version Required:** Built with VASSAL 3.7.18
